posts.text:
🗣️ @ericbenet came through to promote his new single, "Who's Gonna Save Us?" But who really is going to save us? Eric breaks down why Black people have historically aspired to seek protection through fame and money—and how those things can sometimes shield people from accountability. If the power isn't in representation then where does the real power reside?
Tap in for the full conversation on @Netflix. 🎥

What are your thoughts on situations like this?
